title: Pırpır Sakinleşiyor
author: Çağrı Odabaşı
description: Deep in the river forest lives Pırpır, a tiny, speedy piranha whose anger can flare up when things don’t go his way. Whether he is asked to share his favorite toy, wait his turn at the playground, or eat something other than what he expected, his big reactions sometimes hurt those around him. With the gentle guidance of his parents, Pırpır discovers that feeling angry is perfectly normal, the important thing is learning how to manage it. Through deep breathing, empathy, and taking a moment to understand what lies behind his feelings, he gradually learns to respond more calmly and consider others.
